description: shadcn-svelte's checkbox examples basic, description (checked), disabled, invalid (aria-invalid under a data-invalid Field) and group (a Field.Set with a legend and four checkboxes, two checked) over bits-ui's Checkbox compiled from its published source, through the unmodified checkbox, label and field wrappers; every Checkbox passes a name, so bits-ui's `name = undefined` default never runs. Toggled by clicks on the boxes and by Space on the focused box, Tab to the next box (its :focus-visible ring), the disabled box ignoring a click; aria-checked, data-state and the hidden inputs' checked property, at 800 and 420 px wide
